chip.description: V30-core 16-bit processor with the same integrated peripheral set as the V25 (uPD70330 family). Arcade boards fit the ROM-less variant executing from external program ROM, frequently with an opcode-scrambling security table; the Irem M92/M107 sound CPU and various Toaplan and Sega System 32 CPUs are V35s.
chip.notes: src/devices/cpu/nec/v25.cpp in MAME 0.288 implements V25 and V35 together; src/mame/irem/m107.cpp instantiates "required_device<v35_device> m_soundcpu". Filed cpu on taxonomy TB2 for the same reason as the V25 row.
